title: Alignment Services & Plans Cancellation Settlement and Holder Confirmation
content:
## Settlement of a cancelled alignment plan

**Completion.** A plan cancellation under Alignment Services & Plans is completed when the holder confirms the cancellation request the agent registered on the plan, and the refund is booked with it.

**Refund.** For a plan whose cancellation the holder confirms under this policy, and only for such a plan, the refund is the amount this policy settles: every included alignment already performed, the purchase-day alignment included, is deducted at the value this policy gives it, the charges of the plan's work orders dated the cancellation day are settled from it, and it is never below 0.00; alignments charged at the member early price and readjustments are not deducted.

**When the refund is fixed and paid.**

> The refund of a cancelled plan is fixed only after every work order on the plan dated the cancellation day carries its service basis.

> The refund of a cancelled plan is not paid until the parts on the plan's work orders of the cancellation day have been priced by the plan desk.

Put the other way round: while any work order on the plan dated the cancellation day still shows its service basis open, the refund of that plan is not yet fixed.

## The holder's confirmation: `confirm_alignment_cancellation_b0865de9`

**Capability.** The plan holder confirms a pending cancellation request for their own alignment plan. On success the request becomes confirmed, the plan is closed with status cancelled and a closing date of today, and a refund entry is booked on the plan for the refund amount and tender given, which the holder can see on the plan's activity.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_alignment_cancellation_b0865de9` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
- `alignment_cancel_request_id` — reference number of the cancellation request awaiting the holder's confirmation, given to the holder by the agent from the plan's cancellation request lookup (text).
- `alignment_plan_id` — reference number of the alignment plan being cancelled, given to the holder by the agent from the alignment plan lookup (text).
- `refund_amount` — refund paid to the holder, in the refund entry's format: USD with 2 decimal places, never negative, and 0.00 when the refund works out to nothing; the tool rounds to the nearest cent when more digits are given.
- `refund_tender` — where the refund goes: `cash_or_debit` when the plan was paid in cash or with a debit card; `bank_card` when the plan was paid with an outside bank credit card. The value `none` names no tender and is not accepted; `crestline_card` is not accepted because a refund to the Crestline card posts through the card account; `fleet_account` is not accepted because a refund to a fleet account posts through that account.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `alignment_cancel_request_id`, `request_status` (the text confirmed), `alignment_plan_id`, `plan_status` (the text cancelled), `closed_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `refund_event_id` (reference number of the booked refund entry), `refund_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `refund_tender`. A `refund_tender` outside the accepted values returns a text starting with "Error:" and changes nothing.
